Network Design Optimization : Applied K-means clustering for network design optimization of 2500 delivery centres. Built OSRM-backend instance(routing engine) on AWS EC2 for distance and routing calculations and benchmarked it against Google Maps API, reducing annual costs by ∼ 2 cr and improving computation time by ∼ 84%.
